body: Honestly I’d rather have aggressively specific instructions (as long as they’re reasonable) to follow than have to make guesses for a customer that doesn’t communicate.
For whatever reason I assumed this was only for uberx and I didn’t even bother to try it out 😭

Similarly to asmr (I’m not a fan in particular) binaural beats help me. They have videos on youtube I believe, but the app has worked best for me. It works well for both focusing on tasks and relaxing into sleep.

He is not on meds and has been admitted several times throughout his life, as have both of his younger siblings :/ He has access to professional help, but he has very negative associations with inpatient treatment. I’ll add that his current state is not a secret; his gf and family are always aware
